messages:
maria: Hey sec team — legal just pinged us. ACME has a court-ordered eDiscovery hold; they need redwood-payments SIEM logs kept 365d instead of our default 90d. Can we do a timeboxed retention exception + KMS-wrapped export?
aj: Need the legal hold copy + scope before we approve. Also: what exact indices/events are in scope?
maria: attaching summary in ticket (will post link). Scope: `auth`, `payments_api`, `chargeback` indices + transaction traces. Minimal request text: retain those indices 365d for ACME org id. Timebox = 12 months.
devon: For the export flow I want to avoid broad role changes. Proposal: create a short-lived export bucket with server-side encryption using a dedicated KMS key (ephemeral) and grant `siem-export-acme` role that is time-limited. After timebox, revoke role and rotate/destroy key.
sre-bot: Policy check: current exporter config DOES NOT allow retention > 180d without compliance-approval. Blocked until `approval_id` present.
audit-bot: Logged request 2026-03-20T09:00Z id=eh-98765. Please reference audit id in approvals.
lee: Implementation notes: 1) create KMS key with key policy limiting Admins={secops, audit}, AllowUse only to exporter service and the ephemeral role; 2) set exporter config with `retention_days: 365`, `kms_key_alias: alias/siem/acme/ephemeral`, `timebox_until: 2027-03-20`; 3) enable field-redaction pipeline for account numbers/email.
maria: redaction is required by legal. Here's a quick pipeline snippet we tested: ```json
{"pipeline": [{"match": {"field": "email"}}, {"action": "mask"}, {"match": {"field": "card_number"}}, {"action": "tokenize"}]}
```
devon: That looks good. We should avoid storing raw PANs in the export. Tokenize then store token map inside HSM-wrapped secret in KMS.
aj: Compliance asks for justification doc + retention approval ticket referencing audit id. Also require a runbook for post-timebox deletion and verification.
lee: RBAC change path: add role `siem:export:acme:365` scoped to `resource:export/buckets/acme-eh-98765` and `actions: s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject`. Role creation requires PR -> staging test -> approval by sec-eng and compliance.
maria: I'll file the PR + ticket now (link: https://rwd/ops/tickets/ACME-eh-98765). Also creating the exporter config PR #4231.
audit-bot: Note: retention exception will be added to the audit register once compliance approves. Save all approvals as artifacts.
sre-bot: Automation note: once PR merges, a workflow will create the KMS alias and S3 bucket, run the exporter, and emit `export_snapshot_id`. We'll require `--ttl=365d` and a lifecycle rule to move to cold archive after 90d if requested.
devon: One more: we should create an automated verification job that checks the export object encryption headers and key-id match the alias, then write a hash of the exported archive into the audit log.
lee: Deletion runbook snippet (post-timebox): 1) revoke `siem:export:acme:365` role; 2) rotate and schedule deletion for ephemeral KMS key; 3) two-person verification to purge S3 bucket and record hashes.
aj: Sounds good. Compliance prefers timebox = 12 months but we will re-evaluate 60 days before expiry. Approve pending: legal-hold doc + PR link + runbook attached.
maria: Got it. I'll upload legal doc and ping again when PR is live. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
lee: I'll draft the role PR template and add the automated verification job to the staging pipeline.
devon: I'll add field-redaction tests to the exporter CI.
audit-bot: Action items created: eh-98765: [collect legal doc, PR #4231, runbook link, verification logs].
maria: closing loop — will update here when each artifact is in.
